name: Phrase
description:
Phrase MCP connects your AI agent directly to Phrase the Language Intelligence Platform, no custom integration required. Instead of building against an API or logging into a dashboard, you sign in with your existing Phrase account and your agent can act right away.

Ask it to check on a job, run a quality evaluation, pull from your translation memories and term bases, or manage files and projects, all in plain language, from wherever you're already working. It only does what your Phrase role already allows, so connecting it never expands your access.

Note: this connector is for the EU server. On the US server? Consult https://developers.phrase.com/en/mcp-server

_published_faq.name: How do I add Phrase to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Phrase to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.eu.phrase.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Phrase MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Phrase lists 35 MCP tools, including connectors_read_api, connectors_search_api, connectors_write_api, control_hub_read_api, control_hub_search_api, control_hub_write_api, kb_lookup, kb_page, kb_search, language_ai_read_api, language_ai_search_api, and language_ai_write_api.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Phrase?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Phrase in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Phrase requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Phrase is developed by Phrase. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
